string.name: internet_reason
string.value: Needed to perform network diagnostic tests to M-Lab servers

string.name: policy_sec1_body
string.value: NDT7 (Network Diagnostic Tool) performs active network tests to measure throughput, round-trip latency, and packet loss using M-Lab open infrastructure.

string.name: policy_sec2_body
string.value:
• Public IP address & approximate ISP/AS network
• Download & upload throughput measurements
• TCP diagnostics (RTT, jitter, retransmission)
• Timestamps and test duration

string.name: policy_sec3_body
string.value: All measurement results are published publicly and permanently in M-Lab's open research dataset (BigQuery and Google Cloud Storage) to support global Internet research.

string.name: policy_sec4_body
string.value: No personal identification, contacts, device files, or precise GPS coordinates are ever accessed. By clicking Agree, you accept the M-Lab Data Policy.
